title: 'work the loose stone by the ivy (wits)' at the barrow door shows a normal DC/roll UI (DC 11, roll 10+ succeeds) but returns the identical failure line ('There is a trick to it you have not found') on every attempt regardless of the die shown, strongly implying the check cannot succeed at all until the hunter's hint is obtained. The UI should not present it as a live probability check if it is actually gated by a missing flag.
where: Barrow Field / 'work the loose stone by the ivy'
